The Exchange Offer expired on October 28, 2026, and the Issuer announced the final results of the Exchange Offer on November 2, 2026. Upon that announcement, the tender of Predecessor Shares by Scorpio Holdings and SSH, and their corresponding commitment to acquire the Shares, became irrevocable. As a result, as of November 4, 2026, the Reporting Persons ceased to beneficially own any Predecessor Shares and acquired 49,356,825 Shares in exchange, representing approximately 13.89% of the outstanding Shares. The Reporting Persons first became holders of Predecessor Shares in connection with the Predecessor Issuer's business combination with Eneti Inc., which was completed in December 2023, and thereafter increased their position through private placements by the Predecessor Issuer completed in February 2024 and March 2026. The funds used to acquire the Predecessor Shares that were exchanged in the Exchange Offer came from the working capital of Scorpio Holdings and SSH.
